findings.evidence: Lines 374-379: docstring text vs. statement `w ⬝ᵥ (flavorBlindMatrix qq qg gq gg *ᵥ f) = qq * (w ⬝ᵥ f)`; the module docstring at lines 38-40 phrases the same result correctly.
findings.fix: Rephrase as: "the non-singlet combination `w ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ f)` of the evolved vector is `qq` times the same combination `w ⬝ᵥ f` of `f`".
findings.issue: Docstring of `dotProduct_flavorBlindMatrix_mulVec_of_mem_nonSinglet` calls `w ⬝ᵥ f` "the combination of the components of `P *ᵥ f`"; read literally it asserts `w ⬝ᵥ f = qq * (w ⬝ᵥ f)`. The statement is `w ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ f) = qq * (w ⬝ᵥ f)`.

findings.evidence: Lines 146-149, 389-395, 397-402: each docstring describes a weaker claim than the theorem statement directly below it.
findings.fix: State the computed image in the two `mulVec_` docstrings (membership is already covered by `flavorBlindMatrix_mulVec_mem_singletSector`), and say "any vector supported on the gluon" at line 146.
findings.issue: Docstrings narrower than the results: `flavorBlindMatrix_mulVec_singletVector` (line 389) and `flavorBlindMatrix_mulVec_single_gluon` (line 397) say only "maps ... into the singlet sector", but each computes the explicit image (`qq • singletVector + (2 * card Flavor * gq) • Pi.single gluon 1`, resp. `qg • singletVector + gg • Pi.single gluon 1`); `singlet_single_gluon` (line 146) says "the gluon basis vector" while the statement covers `Pi.single gluon b` for every `b`.

summary: The module docstring is accurate, roadmap-free and properly referenced, and all main definitions and theorems are documented. One main-statement docstring misstates the result it documents, and three others describe strictly less than their statements prove.
